# El Castillo Commissary

> City of Houston–approved food truck commissary at 6345 Skyline Dr, Houston, TX 77057, open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. One stop for mobile food vendors: propane refills, ice, grocery and supplies, deep cleaning and truck wash, truck servicing, and custom food truck builds.

Note: this page is a website concept by ARO Solutions. The official site is https://elcastillotx.com/.

## Key facts
- Address: 6345 Skyline Dr, Houston, TX 77057 (Mid West Houston, near the Galleria)
- Phone: +1 346-254-2525
- Hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Status: on the City of Houston's list of health-department-approved commissaries
- Google rating: 4.6 (22 reviews, October 2026)
- Languages: English and Spanish

## Services
- Commissary membership (approved base for a Houston mobile food unit permit)
- Propane refills
- Ice, grocery and supplies
- Deep cleaning and covered wash bay
- Food truck servicing
- Custom food truck builds, from the frame up

## Common questions
- Do food trucks in Houston need a commissary? Yes. Houston requires mobile food units to operate from an approved commissary, and Texas requires units in large counties like Harris to return to their commissary within the 24 hours before operating (Health & Safety Code §437.0074).
- Is El Castillo open 24 hours? Yes, 24/7.
